name: trace-call
prompt:
In tools/qwen/pipeline.py add a new function `trace_call(system, user, answer, completion_tokens)` directly above `def ask(system, user, max_tokens):`. When the environment variable KK_TRACE_DIR is not set or empty it returns None and writes nothing. Otherwise it creates that directory (os.makedirs with exist_ok=True), writes ONE json file there per call and returns the file path. The file name is time.strftime('%Y%m%dT%H%M%S') + '-' + str(time.time_ns() % 10**9).zfill(9) + '.json' (time, json and os are already imported; add no import). The file holds the object {"model": getattr(LANE, "model", ""), "system": system, "user": user, "answer": answer, "completion_tokens": completion_tokens} written with json.dump(..., ensure_ascii=False, indent=1) and encoding utf-8. Then change the end of `ask`: its last statement is a `return (` with a tuple whose first item is the line `choice["message"]["content"],`. Use ONE edit block that SEARCHes exactly these three lines (copied from the file) and REPLACES them with the call line followed by the same three lines:
    return (
        choice["message"]["content"],
        time.time() - t,
The new line goes BEFORE `return (` at the same indentation as it: `    trace_call(system, user, choice["message"]["content"], v.get("usage", {}).get("completion_tokens", 0))`. Never write `// ...` in an edit block (it only marks skipped lines in the excerpt). Do not wrap or change the return value. Change nothing else.
